serviceArea: Harrogate, Leeds, York and surrounding villages
audience: Homeowners renovating period properties, and interior designers specifying built-in furniture for clients

services.name: Fitted wardrobes and storage
services.description: Built-in wardrobes, alcove units and boot rooms designed around the room and finished on site.

services.name: Kitchens in solid timber
services.description: Hand-built kitchen cabinetry in oak, ash and painted tulipwood, including islands and pantry units.

services.name: Sash window restoration
services.description: Repair and draught-proofing of original box sash windows, including cord replacement and re-glazing.

services.name: Staircases and balustrades
services.description: New staircases and replacement handrails, spindles and newel posts matched to the existing property.

differentiators: Every commission is drawn, made and fitted by the same two joiners
Workshop in Starbeck, so clients can see pieces before installation
Specialists in listed and conservation-area properties
Timber sourced from FSC-certified UK merchants
tone: Warm and plainspoken, confident about craft without being showy. Written for people spending real money on their home.
goals: Get homeowners to request a workshop visit or a home measure
Show the range of work so enquiries arrive better qualified
Make the conservation-property specialism obvious to interior designers
